name: Porch Light
tagline: The care coordination software your whiteboard has been quietly begging you to replace.
positioning: Porch Light runs scheduling, visit notes, and family updates for small home-care agencies — so owner-operators stop coordinating care from a group text at 11pm.

hero.h1: Elder care runs on Post-its. We think that's a little bleak.
hero.sub: Porch Light gives small home-care agencies one calm place for caregiver schedules, visit notes, and the family updates you're currently sending from your personal phone at midnight.

features.title: Schedules that survive a call-out
features.description: When a caregiver phones in sick at 6am, Porch Light shows you who's free, who's qualified, and who's already near the client. No spreadsheet archaeology required.

features.title: Visit notes people actually finish
features.description: Caregivers log meds, meals, and moods from their phone in under a minute. You get a real record instead of 'she seemed fine.'

features.title: Family updates on autopilot
features.description: Adult children get a tidy weekly recap of Mom's visits and vitals — so they stop texting you individually at dinner.

features.title: Compliance without the binder
features.description: Care plans, credentials, and visit signatures live in one audit-ready place. Surveyor shows up? Great. Everything's already there.

features.title: Payroll that matches reality
features.description: Clock-ins, mileage, and visit lengths export straight to your payroll. Bill what you worked, pay what you owe, argue less.

features.title: Live view of every client
features.description: One dashboard: who's been seen today, who hasn't, and which visit is running forty minutes long again.

testimonials.quote: We coordinated 34 clients out of a laminated wall calendar and my memory. Porch Light replaced both, and my memory was the weak link.
testimonials.name: Renata Alvarez

testimonials.quote: The family recap emails alone cut my after-hours calls in half. My spouse has met me again.
testimonials.name: Desmond Achebe

testimonials.quote: A state surveyor asked for six months of visit logs. I clicked twice. She looked almost disappointed.
testimonials.name: Priya Venkatesh

pricing.blurb: For the owner who is also the scheduler, the biller, and occasionally the caregiver.
For growing agencies that finally admitted the whiteboard isn't scaling.
For multi-location operators who need it to just work everywhere.

homepage.footerBlurb: Porch Light is care coordination software for small home-care agencies. Fewer group texts, better visits, and a whiteboard you can finally erase for good.
